name: Verifier for case reopening
description: Verifies if the specified case is reopened with state 'new', reopen count 1 and channel email

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 486 AND state = 'new' AND reopen_count = 1 AND channel = 'email' AND contact_id=38;

name: Verifier for user group and user assignment
description: Verifies if the case is assigned to Christine Evans in CSM Tier 1 Support

validation_config.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customer_case WHERE case_id = 486 AND assignment_group_id = 1 AND assigned_to = 123;
